criteria.description: Works in one of the industries DEPLOY has served: energy, consulting, venture capital, finance, HR tech, education, or enterprise software.
Has roughly 50 to 5,000 employees: big enough to have a dev team and a workflow owner, small enough to need outside AI help.
Has an engineering or IT team, e.g. engineering job posts, a tech blog, or a product they build.
Shows public interest in AI: open AI/ML/automation roles, an announced AI pilot, or AI mentioned as a company priority.
Uses tools DEPLOY works with (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Power BI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), seen in job posts or case studies.
Has high-volume operational work such as support tickets, claims, onboarding, sales operations, or document review.
The company is itself an AI consultancy, AI agency, or AI-native product company.
The company is a big tech company with large in-house AI research teams.
